"""Classify the 183 absent commit strings by full-token shape and occurrence context."""
import json
import re
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

LOG = "/tmp/ledger-forensics/main-94a3dc95-log.txt"
CUTOFF = "2026-10-02T12:56"
NARROW = re.compile(r"astro-plan-[a-z0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)*")
WIDE = re.compile(r"[~./A-Za-z0-9_-]*astro-plan-[A-Za-z0-9._-]*")

rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open("/tmp/ledger-forensics/live/export-all.jsonl")]
issues = [r for r in rows if r.get("_type") == "issue"]
oct2 = {r["id"] for r in issues if r.get("created_at", "") < CUTOFF}
live = {r["id"] for r in issues}
lens = Counter(len(i.split("-", 2)[2].split(".")[0]) for i in live if i.startswith("astro-plan-"))

occ = defaultdict(list)
for rec in open(LOG, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().split("\x1e")[1:]:
    sha, date, parents, body = rec.split("\x1f", 3)
    for m in NARROW.finditer(body):
        s = m.group(0)
        if s in oct2:
            continue
        # widen to the whole whitespace-delimited token for context
        start = m.start()
        while start > 0 and re.match(r"[~./A-Za-z0-9_-]", body[start - 1]):
            start -= 1
        end = m.end()
        while end < len(body) and re.match(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]", body[end]):
            end += 1
        token = body[start:end].rstrip(".,")
        line_start = body.rfind("\n", 0, m.start()) + 1
        line_end = body.find("\n", m.end())
        line = body[line_start: line_end if line_end != -1 else len(body)]
        trailer = re.match(r"^\s*([A-Z][A-Za-z-]+):\s", line)
        occ[s].append({
            "sha": sha,
            "date": date,
            "token": token,
            "trailer": trailer.group(1) if trailer else None,
            "line": line.strip()[:160],
        })

HASH = re.compile(r"^astro-plan-[a-z0-9]{3,6}(?:\.[0-9]+)*$")


def classify(s, o):
    tokens = Counter(x["token"] for x in o)
    suffix = s[len("astro-plan-"):].split(".")[0]
    compound = [t for t in tokens if t != s and t.startswith(s + "-")]
    pathlike = [t for t in tokens if t != s and not t.startswith("astro-plan-")]
    if compound and all(t.startswith("astro-plan-wisp-") for t in compound):
        return "non_id_truncated_wisp_reference", "regex stopped at the hyphen; full tokens are wisp ids " + ", ".join(sorted(set(compound)))
    if pathlike and all(t != s for t in tokens):
        return "non_id_path_or_repo_name", "every occurrence is part of a path or repository name: " + ", ".join(sorted(tokens))
    if suffix.isalpha() and len(suffix) >= 7:
        return "non_id_word", "dictionary word, longer than any live hash id"
    if HASH.match(s):
        if "." not in s[len("astro-plan-"):]:
            return "bead_id", "hash-shaped id"
        return "bead_id_child", "hash-shaped hierarchical child id"
    return "unclassified", ""


result = []
for s in sorted(occ):
    o = occ[s]
    cls, why = classify(s, o)
    parent = s.split(".")[0]
    result.append({
        "string": s,
        "class": cls,
        "reason": why,
        "parent_root": parent,
        "parent_root_in_live": parent in live,
        "occurrences": len(o),
        "commit_count": len({x["sha"] for x in o}),
        "first_commit_date": min(x["date"] for x in o),
        "last_commit_date": max(x["date"] for x in o),
        "trailers": sorted({x["trailer"] for x in o if x["trailer"]}),
        "tokens": sorted({x["token"] for x in o}),
        "commits": sorted({x["sha"] for x in o}),
        "sample_line": o[0]["line"],
    })

json.dump(result, open("/tmp/ledger-forensics/absent-183-classified.json", "w"), indent=1)
print("live hash-length distribution", sorted(lens.items()))
print(Counter(r["class"] for r in result))
for r in result:
    if r["class"].startswith("non_id") or r["class"] == "unclassified":
        print(r["string"], r["class"], r["tokens"], r["reason"][:120])
print("roots", Counter(r["parent_root"] for r in result if r["class"].startswith("bead")).most_common(10))
print("dates", Counter(r["first_commit_date"][:10] for r in result).most_common())
print("trailers", Counter(t for r in result for t in r["trailers"]))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build an isolated scratch Dolt store from a copied source, with every remote and
# backup removed. Usage: scratch-store.sh <name> <source> (source is a database dir
# containing .dolt/ or a bare noms dir containing a manifest). Sources must already
# be copies under /tmp/ledger-forensics/.
set -euo pipefail
name="$1"
src="$2"
case "$src" in /tmp/ledger-forensics/*) ;; *) echo "refusing non-isolated source $src" >&2; exit 2;; esac
dst="/tmp/ledger-forensics/stores/$name"
[ -e "$dst" ] && { echo "exists: $dst" >&2; exit 3; }
mkdir -p "$dst/.dolt"
if [ -d "$src/.dolt/noms" ]; then
  cp -R "$src/.dolt/noms" "$dst/.dolt/noms"
elif [ -f "$src/manifest" ]; then
  cp -R "$src" "$dst/.dolt/noms"
else
  echo "no noms store in $src" >&2; exit 4
fi
printf '{\n  "head": "refs/heads/main",\n  "remotes": {},\n  "backups": {},\n  "branches": {}\n}\n' > "$dst/.dolt/repo_state.json"
printf '{}\n' > "$dst/.dolt/config.json"
echo "$dst"
sources.materialise-remote.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Materialise a Dolt gitblobstore commit from the isolated remote-git repo as a scratch
# noms store. Usage: materialise-remote.sh <git-commit> <target-dir>
set -euo pipefail
commit="$1"
target="$2"
repo=/tmp/ledger-forensics/remote-git
noms="$target/.dolt/noms"
mkdir -p "$noms"
git -C "$repo" archive --format=tar "$commit" | tar -x -C "$noms"
# gitblobstore splits large objects into <name>/<NNNN> parts; join them back in order.
for dir in "$noms"/*; do
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    name=$(basename "$dir")
    tmp="$noms/.join-$name"
    : > "$tmp"
    for part in $(ls "$dir" | sort); do
      cat "$dir/$part" >> "$tmp"
    done
    rm -r "$dir"
    mv "$tmp" "$noms/$name"
  fi
done
printf '{\n  "head": "refs/heads/main",\n  "remotes": {},\n  "backups": {},\n  "branches": {}\n}\n' > "$target/.dolt/repo_state.json"
printf '{}\n' > "$target/.dolt/config.json"
echo "materialised $commit into $target"

"""Materialise every distinct storage file ever referenced by the fetched refs/dolt/data
git history (current chain plus the pre-migration chain) for chunk scanning.

Usage: python3 remote_blobs.py <out-dir>
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = "/tmp/ledger-forensics/remote-git"
HEADS = ["refs/dolt/data", "b8d4879b2c2b8e1e858000d3314ee3bbc240a93a", "65b15c985b7510582f48660fd8e1a7126890d569"]


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, *args], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout


out = sys.argv[1]
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
commits = git("rev-list", *HEADS).decode().split()
files = {}  # name -> {part: blob}
for c in commits:
    for line in git("ls-tree", "-r", c).decode().splitlines():
        meta, path = line.split("\t", 1)
        _mode, kind, blob = meta.split()
        if kind != "blob" or path == "manifest":
            continue
        name, _, part = path.partition("/")
        files.setdefault(name, {})[part] = blob
written = 0
for name, parts in files.items():
    dest = os.path.join(out, name)
    if os.path.exists(dest):
        continue
    with open(dest, "wb") as fh:
        for part in sorted(parts):
            fh.write(git("cat-file", "blob", parts[part]))
    written += 1
print("commits", len(commits), "distinct files", len(files), "written", written)

"""Supplementary census: bead-shaped strings outside the reviewed 183 that are absent from
the live ledger, from (a) the baseline tree and (b) commit messages on every ref.

Usage: python3 supplementary.py <baseline-tree-ids.txt>
Writes /tmp/ledger-forensics/supplementary.json.
"""
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys

RX = re.compile(r"astro-plan-[a-z0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)*")
HASH = re.compile(r"^astro-plan-[a-z0-9]{3,6}(?:\.[0-9]+)*$")
WORDS = {"archive", "catalogs", "project", "symlink", "hardlink", "seed", "mockup", "abcd", "aaaa", "wisp", "merge"}

live = set()
for l in open("/tmp/ledger-forensics/live/export-all.jsonl"):
    r = json.loads(l)
    if r.get("_type") == "issue":
        live.add(r["id"])
reviewed = {r["string"] for r in json.load(open("/tmp/ledger-forensics/absent-183-classified.json"))}

tree = set(open(sys.argv[1]).read().split())
commits_all = set()
first_seen = {}
for rec in open("/tmp/ledger-forensics/all-refs-log.txt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().split("\x1e")[1:]:
    sha, date, _parents, body = rec.split("\x1f", 3)
    for m in RX.findall(body):
        commits_all.add(m)
        if m not in first_seen or date < first_seen[m][0]:
            first_seen[m] = (date, sha)


def kind(s):
    word = s[len("astro-plan-"):].split(".")[0]
    if word in WORDS or (word.isalpha() and len(word) >= 7):
        return "non_id"
    return "bead_shaped" if HASH.match(s) else "unclassified"


out = {}
for label, source in (("baseline_tree_94a3dc95", tree), ("commit_messages_all_refs", commits_all)):
    absent = sorted(s for s in source if s not in live and s not in reviewed)
    out[label] = [{"string": s, "kind": kind(s), "first_commit": first_seen.get(s)} for s in absent]
    print(label, "absent outside the 183:", len(absent), {k: sum(1 for x in out[label] if x["kind"] == k) for k in ("bead_shaped", "non_id", "unclassified")})
json.dump(out, open("/tmp/ledger-forensics/supplementary.json", "w"), indent=1)
ids = sorted({x["string"] for v in out.values() for x in v if x["kind"] == "bead_shaped"})
open("/tmp/ledger-forensics/needles-supplementary.txt", "w").write("\n".join(ids) + "\n")
print("supplementary bead-shaped needles", len(ids))

"""Assemble docs/reviews/evidence/2026-10-02/ledger-recovery-comparison.json from the

            if key is None:
                continue
            t = out.setdefault(key, {"files": 0, "chunks_decoded": 0, "errors": 0, "target_hits": 0, "control_hits": 0})
            t["files"] += 1
            if "error" in r:
                t["errors"] += 1
                continue
            t["chunks_decoded"] += r["decoded"]
            for k, n in r["hits"].items():
                t["control_hits" if k in CONTROLS else "target_hits"] += n
    return out

    "live_backup_copy": F + "backup-copy/live-beads-backup-20261016",
    "remote_git_all_storage_files": F + "remote-blobs",
    "remote_pre_migration_snapshot": F + "stores/remote-pre-migration-b8d4879",
    "remote_current_snapshot": F + "stores/remote-current-c928cda",

    "pv_backup_20260826": F + "carriers/home-tmp/platevault-beads-backup-20260826",
    "pv_backup_20260826_tables": F + "stores/pv-backup-20260826",
    "home_beads_backup": F + "carriers/home-beads-backup",
}
scan = scan_totals([F + "chunkscan-stores.jsonl", F + "chunkscan-journals-remoteblobs.jsonl"], groups)
# Journal files the table reader rejected were re-read by the journal reader in the second pass.
for k in ("remote_pre_migration_snapshot", "remote_current_snapshot", "clone_platevault_claude_embedded_tables",
          "clone_platevault_sol_tables", "clone_clean_room_pv_tables"):
    if k in scan:

supp_scan = scan_totals([F + "chunkscan-supplementary.jsonl"], {
    "live_backup_copy": F + "backup-copy/", "remote_git_all_storage_files": F + "remote-blobs",

STORES = {
